title: US midterms: Democrat Talarico wins Texas Senate seat
summary: The Democratic Party is on course for major gains in both the House and Senate, delivering a stinging rebuke to US President Donald Trump and his Republican Party. Follow DW's live updates.
byline: Karl Sexton, Jenipher Camino Gonzalez, Wesley Dockery, Natalie Muller

image.caption: Democrats were celebrating wins in both the Senate and HouseImage: Carlos Barria/REUTERS

blocks.text: Democrat James Talarico wins Texas Senate seat
Democrat James Talarico won the Texas US Senate race, defeating President Donald Trump-backed Republican Ken Paxton, according to AP data.
The win was monumental for Democrats who had not won a Senate election in Texas in 38 years. Talarico's win also moves Democrats closer to clinching control of the Senate.

Trump carried Texas by 14% in 2024. He endorsed Paxton, the Texas attorney general, despite the fact that he was at ​the ‌center of many controversies, including a 2023 impeachment and a securities fraud case.

Talarico, a four-term state legislator, overcame a flood of heavy outside spending, in what became ‌the ​most expensive Senate race of the cycle. Billionaire and Trump ally Elon Musk poured hundreds of millions in support of Paxton himself.
